description: This Java class 'TokenizeTool' provides functionality to generate a cryptographic key and to encrypt a string using AES encryption.

classes.name: TokenizeTool
classes.description: Utility class for tokenizing strings using AES encryption. It initializes a static secret key and provides a method to encrypt strings.

methods.name: tokenizeString
methods.description: Encrypts the given string using AES encryption with a static key and returns the ciphertext as a string.
